Blood Donation Eligibility Checker

Check common blood donation eligibility rules: age, weight, hemoglobin, intervals.

Informational only — the donation center makes the final decision after its own screening. For information only — not medical advice.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter your age, weight, hemoglobin, and sex.
  2. Enter your last whole-blood donation date if any.
  3. Answer the health questions honestly.
  4. Read which rules you pass or fail, and your earliest next donation date.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Why 56 days between donations?

That is the standard minimum interval for whole blood in many countries, giving your body time to replace red cells.

Why does hemoglobin matter?

Donation removes iron-rich red cells. Minimum hemoglobin protects donors from becoming anemic.

Is this a final decision?

No. Donation centers do their own screening and medical history review. This is informational only.
